lien hong think you misunderstand the process of research and the process of supervising student for the latter publication is just last step in it and don have to publish to teach student how to research . for example when working with bsc and msc student always aim to teach them what is proper way to own research project at high quality level . how to literature review efficiently how to identify the research gap ielts potential research question to pursue how to evaluate others paper efficiently eg without spending hour and day reading single paper etc . the next step is to teach them how to set up plan how much time they have what their current ability eg too ambitious project would fail too simple would become garbage etc . next is to understand the importance of risk management plan what to if plan fails etc . the process of ethic approval if needed . how to run experiment properly how to choose state of the art benchmarks how to set up the use case to have comprehensive cover ablation test statistical significance etc . for more theoretical project which claim to prove how to prove them etc . how to make conclusion from the results . now you don need to publish if you want them to learn these steps . publication only happens if as supervisor see there scientific value in the work of the students . since fen my friend primary purpose is to teach them how to the step above properly usually don expect to have publishable outcome at the end and rather prefer to evaluate how well the student have learnt those step properly . hope this make sense .
